title: A file holding one part of the specification, one section of a large part, or the archive of one part

schemaVersion.$comment: The version of this structure the file was written in. Changing the structure is the same event as changing a contract: the files written in the old version have to be found and migrated, and the version is what finds them.

scope.$comment: The part of the specification the file belongs to: a domain, contracts, _guidelines or tech.

section.$comment: The name of the file within its part.
